selection: Lowest date-equal out-of-fold raw Brier within training only, deterministic name tie-break; constant fold-training prevalence is a reference, not an optimized candidate
ensemble: Fixed unweighted mean of all four candidate raw probabilities; no test-chosen weights
calibration: Separate March-June period sigmoid calibration AFTER training-only family selection; it does not select the family
anchor: Existing shallow HGB retrained on identical new train/calibration rows; not the older differently timed artifact
weights: Equal signal-date weights for classifier, scaling, calibration, regression and evaluation
target: Unchanged five observed sessions close return > 0.003
return_point: Shared absolute-error HGB conditional-median proxy, not mathematical expected return
return_interval: Date-weighted 5th/95th percentiles of calibration residuals around the shared point model; empirical 90% band, not a conformal guarantee under time/stock dependence
development_screen: Original information-experiment screen plus selected date-equal interval coverage at least 0.85; no automatic production promotion even if passed
evaluation_role: Previously inspected historical development audit; short October tail is diagnostic only, too short for confidence. No claim of fresh independent evidence
